newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Chilean-led group only bidder for Argentine bank.
newsitem.headline: Chilean-led group only bidder for Argentine bank.

text.p: A group led by Chile's Infisa made the only offer in a tender to buy failed Argentine bank Banco Union Comercial e Industrial (BUCI) Wednesday.
Corp Group offered to assume $400 million in debt and launch a capital increase totaling up to $80 million, according to details of the bid available at the public opening of tender offers.

BUCI President Cecil Munoz told Reuters the offer was complex and that the bank had three days to consider it. The central bank, which took over BUCI's administration last year at the bank's own request, must also approve any deal.

On top of Infisa's bid, Argentina's Banco del Suquia has offered to buy some of BUCI's 48 branches in case no bid to sell the bank is accepted. But Munoz said the central bank wanted to sell the bank as a single unit.
